description: This file defines the Control.Scale class for the Leaflet mapping library, implementing a scale control that displays metric and imperial distances on a map. It includes methods for creating, updating, and removing the scale UI elements, and exports a factory function for instantiation.

classes.name: Scale
classes.description: A class extending Control that provides a scale bar showing distances in metric and imperial units.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Adds the scale control to the map, creates DOM elements, and sets up event listeners for map movements.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes event listeners from the map when the control is removed.

methods.name: _addScales
methods.description: Creates DOM elements for metric and imperial scales based on options.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Calculates the maximum distance in meters based on map size and updates the scales.

methods.name: _updateScales
methods.description: Updates metric and imperial scales if enabled.

methods.name: _updateScale
methods.description: Sets the width and label of a scale element.

methods.name: _getRoundNum
methods.description: Rounds a number to a 'nice' value for display.
